question: Can source identity be encoded together with a constraint so that a small subset preserves all changed conclusions after bounded source withdrawal, including facts requiring several sources jointly?
contract: Each original row is an augmented linear equation over a declared prime field, with a nonempty provenance set of at most g source IDs. Withdrawing a source removes every row depending on it. Preserve the entire augmented row span after any set of at most k source withdrawals, including contradictions and underdetermined answers. This is supplied symbolic evidence, not natural-language extraction or learned rule discovery.
candidate: Assign distinct field values to source IDs. Pad provenance to size g with globally reserved nonwithdrawable IDs. Lift each row by the g-fold exterior product of its source Vandermonde vectors in dimension k+g, tensor its coefficients with that exterior vector, and retain original rows whose lifts extend a basis. The proposed retained-row bound is rank(A) times binomial(k+g,g).
controls: A separate original-row basis for every distinct provenance set
The union of original-row bases for every admissible deletion set
For k=1 and g=1, a primary basis plus quotient-space repairs for each of its sources
Ordinary row basis as an explicitly insufficient negative control

exhaustive.spacesPerGroup: The zero space, each of the eight one-dimensional subspaces, and the full two-dimensional space

tightCases.construction: For each of r independent directions, include one copy for every g-subset of a fixed k+g-source universe. Its complementary k withdrawals make that copy essential.

acceptance: Every admissible deletion produces exactly the independent reference row span for candidate and positive controls. Every selected original row has unchanged coefficients and provenance. Candidate size never exceeds rank(A)*binomial(k+g,g), and all tight cases attain it. Preserve all cases and any mismatch. Beyond-budget requests must fail rather than silently claim correctness.
mechanismScreen: On both redundant families, all three seeds must use at most half the packed bytes of the per-provenance basis and at most 1.1 times the packed bytes of the exhaustive-deletion union basis. This is a retained-certificate feasibility screen only. Record compilation time, peak traced allocation and serialized bytes for every control. No timing superiority or whole-process memory claim follows on a shared host.
priorArt: Vandermonde/exterior representative families, colored matroid fault tolerance, and learning-unlearning are established. The candidate is a memory-oriented construction from these tools; mathematical priority and practical advantage are unestablished. Direct quotient repairs and exhaustive union bases are required strong exact controls. Do not rename this a novel algebra or infer agent utility from supplied equations.
limits: Bounded counterfactual withdrawal, fixed prime and source universe, exact finite-field constraints. Not arbitrary indefinite forgetting, secure erasure, full original-text provenance retention, temporal policy resolution, approximate embeddings, or general agent QA. Row-span equality is stronger than consistency alone. Original source archives are outside the compact certificate and must be charged in any future total-memory claim.
resources: One local standard-library process via uv, no model or paid-service calls, no held-out serving vectors, no changes to calibration or frozen soak.
